visualContract.layoutPolicy: Each family is an explicit Recharts composition using the real ChartContainer, Tooltip and Legend wrappers. The chosen native example Card corner is retained; catalog page dimensions and individual bar/path node coordinates are not layout contracts. Plot width is fluid with a chosen 260px block extent,12/16px ticks and a complete captioned data table. Static fixtures derive geometry from source data; straight segments stand in for runtime natural interpolation and are identified as illustrations. The actual React target preserves source chart type and dataset. Radar uses an explicit 70% outer radius to leave room between its April label and the real legend. Figure gap 12/inset 16, tooltip 8px radius/10px inset and accessible scrollable table are explicit reference choices, not invented universal Figma measurements. Source tooltip actual cn-chart-tooltip class and inline --color-bg/--color-border, including dot/line/dashed, are retained; transient content remains supplementary. Source legend receives a caller className. Series colors are explicit semantic roles; no color alone conveys data. ChartStyle theme selectors require .dark context, while semantic token aliases use data-theme; the target supplies both. The reference passes Pie rootTabIndex=-1 because Recharts Pie otherwise emits a tab stop even with chart accessibilityLayer=false; this prevents an aria-hidden focus target while preserving supplementary pointer hints. No chart role slider/progressbar or focusable graph is invented. Full exact table remains primary, SVG hidden, no animation required; empty/error states never imply zero data.

theme.source: ChartStyle uses .dark ancestor; host must provide it for config.theme and data-theme for semantic tokens.
